```{r cfg, include=FALSE}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CONFIGURATION — edit these values to point at a different model output
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

CFG <- list(

  # Root folder that holds all scheme sub-folders
  plots_root = "/home/athan/DUSTR/01_REPORTS/gpu-2_plots",

  # Data scheme sub-folder name (e.g. "EC_PM_RD_ND_NL", "EC_PM_RD_ND", ...)
  scheme     = "EC_PM_RD_ND_NL",

  # Stats sub-folder name inside <scheme>/ that contains the model_* directories
  # (e.g. "B070_models_stats")
  stats_dir  = "B070_models_stats",

  # ML model name as it appears in the folder (e.g. "XGBoost")
  model      = "XGBoost",

  # Target variable (e.g. "EARTHCARE_DOD_a355", "EARTHCARE_Total_mass")
  target     = "EARTHCARE_DOD_a355",

  # Split to present: "Train", "Test", or "Valid"
  split      = "Valid",

  # GPU / machine prefix used in file names (e.g. "gpu-2")
  gpu_prefix = "gpu-2",

  # [OPTIONAL] Full path to the stats JSON file.
  # Leave as NULL to auto-discover it inside the model folder.
  # Set explicitly if the file lives somewhere unexpected, e.g.:
  #   json_file = "/full/path/to/earthcare_model_stats_....json"
  json_file  = NULL
)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PATH RESOLUTION  — derived automatically from CFG, no manual edits needed
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Stats folder: <plots_root>/<scheme>/<stats_dir>/
batch_dir <- file.path(CFG$plots_root, CFG$scheme, CFG$stats_dir)

# Model folder: model_<MODEL>_<TARGET>_<HASH>_<SPLIT>
# The hash is unknown at config time — discover by listing the batch dir
all_model_dirs <- list.dirs(batch_dir, full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)

folder_pattern <- sprintf("^model_%s_%s_.+_%s$",
                          CFG$model, CFG$target, CFG$split)
matched <- grep(folder_pattern, all_model_dirs, value = TRUE)

if (length(matched) == 0)
  stop(sprintf(
    "No folder matching model=%s, target=%s, split=%s found in:\n  %s\nAvailable:\n  %s",
    CFG$model, CFG$target, CFG$split, batch_dir,
    paste(all_model_dirs, collapse = "\n  ")))

if (length(matched) > 1)
  warning("Multiple matching folders — using the first:\n  ",
          paste(matched, collapse = "\n  "))

plot_dir <- file.path(batch_dir, matched[1])

# JSON stats file: lives inside the model folder (same pattern as PNG files)
# Auto-discover unless CFG$json_file is set explicitly
if (!is.null(CFG$json_file)) {
  json_file <- CFG$json_file
} else {
  # Find any .json file matching the expected naming pattern inside plot_dir
  json_candidates <- list.files(
    plot_dir, pattern = "\\.react\\.internal\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(json_candidates) == 0)
    stop("No *.react.internal.json found in:\n  ", plot_dir,
         "\n  Set CFG$json_file explicitly to override.")
  if (length(json_candidates) > 1)
    warning("Multiple JSON files found — using the first:\n  ",
            paste(json_candidates, collapse = "\n  "))
  json_file <- json_candidates[1]
}

# PNG file prefix: <gpu_prefix>_<scheme>_<stats_dir>_NNN.png
png_prefix <- sprintf("%s_%s_%s", CFG$gpu_prefix, CFG$scheme, CFG$stats_dir)

# Helper: full path for plot index i (zero-padded 3 digits)
plot_path <- function(i) file.path(plot_dir, sprintf("%s_%03d.png", png_prefix, i))

# ── Fail-safes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!file.exists(json_file))
  stop("Stats JSON not found:\n  ", json_file)

missing_plots <- Filter(function(i) !file.exists(plot_path(i)), 0:7)
if (length(missing_plots) > 0)
  stop("Missing plot(s) for index(es): ", paste(missing_plots, collapse = ", "),
       "\n  Expected in: ", plot_dir)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)

# ── Load & filter metrics ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_stats <- fromJSON(json_file)

# Keep only rows matching the configured target
target_stats <- subset(all_stats, target == CFG$target)

if (nrow(target_stats) == 0)
  stop("Target '", CFG$target, "' not found in JSON. Available: ",
       paste(unique(all_stats$target), collapse = ", "))

# Pull each split into a named list for easy inline reference
get_split <- function(sp) {
  row <- subset(target_stats, split == sp)
  if (nrow(row) == 0) return(NULL)
  as.list(row[1, ])
}

tr <- get_split("Train")
te <- get_split("Test")
va <- get_split("Valid")

# Focused split (the one being presented)
vs <- get_split(CFG$split)
if (is.null(vs))
  stop("Split '", CFG$split, "' not found in JSON for target '", CFG$target, "'")

# ── Metric formatting helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
fmt  <- function(x, d = 3) formatC(round(x, d), format = "f", digits = d)
fmt4 <- function(x)        formatC(round(x, 4), format = "f", digits = 4)
pct  <- function(x)        paste0(formatC(round(x * 100, 1), format = "f", digits = 1), " %")

# ── Summary metric table (Train / Test / Valid columns) ────────────────────────
make_col <- function(s) {
  if (is.null(s)) return(rep("—", 9))
  c(s$n_valid,
    fmt(s$rmse), fmt(s$mae), fmt4(s$bias),
    fmt(s$r2), fmt(s$r_pearson), fmt(s$r_spearman),
    pct(s$metric_accuracy_10pct), pct(s$metric_accuracy_20pct))
}

metric_table <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("n", "RMSE", "MAE", "Bias", "R²", "r (Pearson)", "r (Spearman)",
             "Acc ±10 %", "Acc ±20 %"),
  Train  = make_col(tr),
  Test   = make_col(te),
  Valid  = make_col(va),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

## `r paste(CFG$model, "·", CFG$target)` {.build}

**Scheme:** `r CFG$scheme` &nbsp;|&nbsp;
**Model:** `r CFG$model`

```{r metrics-table}
kable(metric_table, align = c("l", "r", "r", "r"),
      col.names = c("Metric", "Train", "Test", "Valid"))
```

---

## 1 · Observed vs Modelled {.flexbox .vcenter}

```{r scatter, out.width="82%", fig.align="center"}
include_graphics(plot_path(0))
```

\scriptsize Hexbin scatter (log\textsubscript{10} count) | R\textsuperscript{2} = `r fmt(vs$r2)` · r = `r fmt(vs$r_pearson)` · RMSE = `r fmt(vs$rmse)` · n = `r vs$n_valid`
\normalsize

---

## 2 · Bias distribution (KDE) {.flexbox .vcenter}

```{r bias-kde, out.width="78%", fig.align="center"}
include_graphics(plot_path(1))
```

\scriptsize Residuals (Pred $-$ Obs). Mean bias = `r fmt4(vs$bias)` · $\sigma$ = `r fmt(vs$metric_resid_std)`
\normalsize

---

## 3 · Bias by predicted — quantile bins {.flexbox .vcenter}

```{r bias-pred-q, out.width="88%", fig.align="center"}
include_graphics(plot_path(2))
```

\scriptsize 10 equal-count decile bins of \textbf{predicted} `r CFG$target`. Bias near zero across deciles; spread grows in the top bin.
\normalsize

---

## 4 · Bias by observed — quantile bins {.flexbox .vcenter}

```{r bias-obs-q, out.width="88%", fig.align="center"}
include_graphics(plot_path(3))
```

\scriptsize 10 equal-count decile bins of \textbf{observed} `r CFG$target`. Slight negative bias in the highest decile — regression-to-the-mean at extreme values.
\normalsize

---

## 5 · Bias by predicted — linear bins {.flexbox .vcenter}

```{r bias-pred-lin, out.width="88%", fig.align="center"}
include_graphics(plot_path(4))
```

\scriptsize Linear-spaced bins reveal data imbalance — bulk of samples at low values. Bias widens in the sparse high-value regime.
\normalsize

---

## 6 · Bias by observed — linear bins {.flexbox .vcenter}

```{r bias-obs-lin, out.width="88%", fig.align="center"}
include_graphics(plot_path(5))
```

\scriptsize Growing negative bias (under-prediction) at high observed values ($<$ 4\,\% of data). Low-to-moderate range well-captured (bulk of samples).
\normalsize

---

## 7 · Bias by latitude {.flexbox .vcenter}

```{r bias-lat, out.width="92%", fig.align="center"}
include_graphics(plot_path(6))
```

\scriptsize Bias stratified by latitude band. Median bias near zero in all bins — no systematic geographic drift.
\normalsize

---

## 8 · Bias by hour (UTC) {.flexbox .vcenter}

```{r bias-hour, out.width="92%", fig.align="center"}
include_graphics(plot_path(7))
```

\scriptsize Bias stratified by overpass hour (UTC). Consistent across all hours — no diurnal artefact.
\normalsize

---

## Summary {.build}

**`r CFG$split` performance — `r CFG$target`** &nbsp;(n = `r vs$n_valid`)


| | |
|---|---|
| R² / r | `r fmt(vs$r2)` / `r fmt(vs$r_pearson)` |
| RMSE / MAE | `r fmt(vs$rmse)` / `r fmt(vs$mae)` |
| Bias | `r fmt4(vs$bias)` |
| Acc ±10 % / ±20 % | `r pct(vs$metric_accuracy_10pct)` / `r pct(vs$metric_accuracy_20pct)` |


**Key findings:**

- Model explains `r pct(vs$r2)` of `r CFG$target` variance with near-zero global bias
- Under-prediction grows at high values — sparse samples in the high-value regime
- No geographic or diurnal systematic errors
